lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, demonstrating a semi-regular 2D spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense population of high-luminance blobs clearly visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, particularly along the leading edge.
